final: SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) / SUM(s.volm3) AS area_to_volume, SUM(s.aream2) / SUM(s.volm3) - (SELECT AVG(source_ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM(s2.aream2) / SUM(s2.volm3) AS source_ratio FROM projects p2 JOIN scanspatial s2 ON s2.arcref = p2.arcregistry WHERE s2.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s2.volm3 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p2.fundflux)) AS above_cross_source_average FROM projects p JOIN scanspatial s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxx <> 0 AND s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux HAVING SUM(s.aream2) / SUM(s.volm3) > (SELECT AVG(source_ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM(s2.aream2) / SUM(s2.volm3) AS source_ratio FROM projects p2 JOIN scanspatial s2 ON s2.arcref = p2.arcregistry WHERE s2.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s2.volm3 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p2.fundflux))
